name: Adobe Firefly — GCS Presigned Storage
description: Registers a Google Cloud Storage presigner for the adobe-firefly-core storage seam: signs V4 read URLs for Firefly inputs and V4 write URLs for outputs (storage: "external"). Mutually exclusive with the S3/Azure presigners. Install @google-cloud/storage.
checklist: Install the Google Cloud Storage SDK (the only channel — manifests have no deps field): npm install @google-cloud/storage
Set ADOBE_GCS_BUCKET; grant the runtime service account access on it (roles/storage.objectViewer for inputs + roles/storage.objectCreator for outputs, or roles/storage.objectAdmin for both)
Provide credentials via the Google ADC chain: set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service-account key for local dev; on Cloud Run/GCE/GKE use the attached service account

V4 signing without a local key file uses the IAM Credentials SignBlob API — grant the service account roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on itself and enable the IAM Credentials API, or getSignedUrl cannot sign
Import the registration once at startup, before any Firefly service call: import './infrastructure/adobe/storage/gcs-register'
Pass GCS object names (not full URLs) as input/output refs — the adapter signs read for inputs, write for outputs (an http(s) ref is passed through unchanged)
